description: Convert a SysML v2 model between the representations OpenSysML writes — textual notation, RDF Turtle, the API's JSON element form — (the Convert RPC, the CLI's -convert). Name the model by modelHash, paths or sources (the source the parse read is converted), or by filePath or inline content read afresh. Nothing is written to disk: the converted document comes back as `content` for the agent to write. A SysML v1 model is refused with INVALID_ARGUMENT: use migrate. The result is the ConvertResponse as protojson writes it.

compact.description: for api-json from notation: write the compact document (api-json-compact/1) instead of the element array

content.description: the document to convert, inline (an empty string is an empty document); fromFormat must then say what it is

documents.description: for a parsed model, the documents whose elements are written, named as the parse named them; empty writes every document

filePath.description: a file to convert, read afresh in the format its extension names (or fromFormat), absolute or relative to the workspace root; instead of modelHash, paths or sources

fromFormat.description: sysml, kerml, text, ttl, turtle, rdf, api-json or json; empty infers from filePath's extension and is notation for a parsed model

idForm.description: how derived element ids are spelled when notation is written as a graph (ttl or api-json): qualified (the default) or uuid

includeCheckDiagnostics.description: notation sources: report the semantic check's diagnostics alongside the output, each with its severity and code as parse reports them; off, only syntax errors are reported

keepDerived.description: with omitDerived: the derived properties still written, as owner or qualifiedName

modelHash.description: the model_hash a parse answered; give this, or paths and/or sources to parse first

omitDerived.description: with compact: leave out every derived property of the metamodel except keepDerived

paths.description: model files to parse as one model, absolute or relative to the workspace root

sources.description: documents given inline, parsed with paths as one model

language.description: sysml or kerml; empty is inferred from path's extension, sysml when it has none

path.description: name the document is reported by in diagnostics and indexed under; a .kerml extension makes it KerML unless language says otherwise

text.description: the document's source text; empty is an empty document

strictConformance.description: judge the documents as conforming SysML v2: notation no pinned production admits is an error rather than a warning

toFormat.description: format to write: sysml, kerml, text, ttl, turtle, rdf, api-json or json

tolerateSyntaxErrors.description: notation to notation only: write the notation back out even when the parser could not read all of it, reporting syntax errors as diagnostics

name: convert
